title: Gluten-Free Coconut Cream Pastry
description: A delicious gluten-free pastry filled with a creamy coconut cream, perfect for a sweet treat.
instructions: Roll out the Algerian Pastry Dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the pastry for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Allow the pastry to cool completely on a wire rack.
In a separate bowl, whip the Coconut Cream until stiff peaks form.
Fold in the whipped Low Fat Cream until well combined.
Add the Granulated Sugar and Vanilla Extract, if using, and mix until combined.
Spoon the coconut cream mixture into the cooled pastry shell.
Dust with Confectioners Sugar, if desired.
